candidates.description: This feature activates on the character sequence "um" within various words and subword tokens.
This feature vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "at" and words containing it.
These tokens represent the mathematical, physical, and abstract concepts of accumulation, spreading, and limits within dynamic systems.
This vector activates for terms and roots related to scientific observation, terminology, and systematic study.
These tokens represent the French demonstrative determiner "ce" (along with its gender/number variants and morphological fragments starting with the letters c-e or c-i).
This vector activates in response to common French grammatical words and connectors.
This vector is related to common French verb forms and contractions (such as "est", "faire", "sont", and "soit").
This feature vector activates on words, roots, and suffixes containing the linguistic sequence "-ist-" or "-exist-".
These tokens function as French adverbial modifiers and conjunctive adverbs that indicate manner, time, frequency, or logical emphasis within a sentence.
This vector represents adjectives denoting likelihood, feasibility, or general attributes of states and objects.
